tools.name: search_law
tools.description: Full-text search over Moroccan legislation articles (and texts by number or title, e.g. "65.99" or "مدونة الشغل"). Returns article snippets with URLs.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One article of a text, exactly as published, with its citation block (canonical URL, marker, text title and number, consolidated date, official PDF).

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Metadata of a law/decree (title, number, dates, Bulletin officiel, official PDF) and its table of contents with article keys.

tools.name: get_versions
tools.description: Previous wordings of an article with their validity dates, and the current wording.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Subject categories (المادة المدنية, Matière commerciale…) with their slugs and text counts.
